facility: Caen Hill Pumping Station, Kennet and Avon Canal, UK
source: Arcadis for Canal & River Trust, Caen Hill Pumping Station Pump Audit Summary Report, 2020 (Interreg Green WIN public deliverable)
question: Audit the Caen Hill pumping station. The operator reports short bearing and seal life, gasket failures and higher than expected energy use. Using the site tests, SCADA data and system description, diagnose the causes (hydraulic, vibration, surge, control), quantify any unexplained losses with the simulator, and recommend measures with their expected benefit.

criteria.name: Duty philosophy - normal operation
criteria.value: 2x pumps duty/assist installed but operated duty/duty in parallel at fixed 48 Hz via Lock 50 level telemetry; 30 s VSD ramp

criteria.name: Operating speed for assessment
criteria.value: 48 Hz normal running frequency; test points at 50, 48, 45 Hz

criteria.name: Preferred Operating Region (POR)
criteria.value: 70% to 120% of flow at BEP - vibration lowest inside POR

criteria.name: Vibration acceptance limit adopted
criteria.value: 11.2 mm/s RMS velocity (WIMES 1.03 single-channel/screw pump limit applied as reasonable limit to 2-channel CT3240); BS ISO 10816-7 damage risk >9.5 mm/s noted but submersibles excluded from scope

criteria.name: Vibration measurement basis
criteria.value: Generally per BS ISO 10816 Part 7, magnetic transducer at drive bearing end (above volute) X/Y/Z + mounting plate corner, 11 Sept 2019

criteria.name: NPSH adequacy criterion
criteria.value: NPSHa must exceed NPSHr with margin; report calculates ~4 m margin, volute below canal level and fully primed

criteria.name: Intake submergence / bellmouth clearance
criteria.value: ANSI/HI 9.8 ideal 0.3D to 0.5D bellmouth above wet-well floor (D = bellmouth diameter)

criteria.name: Energy performance metric
criteria.value: String (wire-to-water including VSD) efficiency and specific energy in kWh/100 m3 from VSD input power, flow and pressure at audit

criteria.name: Energy ranking observed
criteria.value: 48 Hz lower specific energy than 50 Hz or 45 Hz; 2-pump parallel higher specific energy / lower efficiency than single-pump due to left-of-BEP operation

criteria.name: Bearing life expectation
criteria.value: Design life 50,000 hours vs observed 2,000-3,000 hours - short life indicative of excessive vibration

criteria.name: Surge analysis basis
criteria.value: VariSim basic transient model at 48 Hz: uncontrolled 2-pump trip, uncontrolled 1-pump trip (two running), controlled stop 30 s ramp; with intermediate NRVs failed open and working

criteria.name: Pipework installation criteria
criteria.value: Xylem install: critical pipework length 6-7 m, first support <=2.3 m, subsequent supports at 4.8 m; NRVs should achieve 3 or 5 diameters from pump delivery; supports/anchors to avoid residual forces/moments

definitions.definition: Capacity with largest unit out of service = one pump running alone
Overall wire-to-water efficiency including VSD, derived from measured VSD input power
Check-valve slam pressure spike after pump trip/stop due to poor dynamic response of ball check valves

criteria.question: Audit Caen Hill PS: diagnose short bearing/seal life, gasket failures and high energy use from site tests, SCADA and system description (hydraulic, vibration, surge, control), quantify unexplained losses with simulator, recommend measures with expected benefit.

standards.name: BS ISO 10816-7
standards.use: Vibration measurement/evaluation guidance; 9.5 mm/s RMS damage risk noted, submersibles excluded

standards.name: WIMES 1.03 cl.7.2.3 / 7.1.1
standards.use: Dry-well submersible vibration testing: 70-120% BEP, 7.1 mm/s multivane/vortex, 11.2 mm/s single-channel/screw - 11.2 applied to 2-vane as reasonable limit

standards.name: ANSI/HI 9.8
standards.use: Pump intake design - bellmouth-to-floor 0.3D-0.5D to limit silt/debris deposition

rfi.issue: Installed vs operated duty: Table 1 says Duty/Assist but control says both parallel duty/duty fixed speed
rfi.item: Duty configuration and firm capacity definition
rfi.reason: Conflict affects which flow is firm and how efficiency/POR assessed
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: assess both single-pump as firm capacity and two-pump parallel as installed peak; reason - site tests and SCADA cover both modes and report derives both operating points

rfi.issue: Raw suction/delivery pressures, wet-well depths and GPS elevations not tabulated in summary; only derived curves and Table 3/4 summaries shown
rfi.item: Test head and static head basis
rfi.reason: Cannot independently recompute system curve without raw heads
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: adopt reported datums (wet well 55.5 mAOD, pump CL 54.3 mAOD, discharge 127.6 mAOD = ~72 m static rise) as static basis; reason - these are the only quoted levels and rise matches 72 m

rfi.issue: Extra K=120 to match SCADA delivery pressure on <25-yr ductile iron main - roughness, air, partial blockage or valve loss not separated
rfi.reason: Core energy-loss quantification needs split between normal friction and anomaly
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: treat K=120 as anomaly to be quantified with simulator vs clean-pipe friction; reason - report flags it as concern requiring high loss coefficients

rfi.issue: Intermediate NRVs condition unknown, buried under concrete covers in remote towpath, not inspected
rfi.item: NRV operability for surge and head loss
rfi.reason: Surge peaks and system curve depend on whether NRVs hold or stand open
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: model worst case as failed open (not operational) for surge diagnosis and as potential loss/blockage source; reason - report does this and notes high transients on that assumption

rfi.issue: Flow from existing electromagnetic flowmeter, calibration/uncertainty and SCADA estimation method for 2018 daily volumes not stated
rfi.reason: Energy and system-curve conclusions rely on this meter but it is not used for control
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: accept meter as reference for audit with noted uncertainty; reason - same meter used for test and SCADA correlation

rfi.issue: Power only at VSD input via temporary Fluke; separate VSD, motor and pump efficiencies not given; 224 kW reading exceeds 215 kW motor rating
rfi.reason: Cannot isolate VSD vs motor vs pump loss without nameplate curves
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: use reported wire-to-water STRING efficiency for comparisons; reason - defined as including VSD and is the only consistent metric

rfi.issue: NPSH ~4 m margin calculation inputs (levels, vapour pressure, suction losses with silted screens) not shown
rfi.reason: Cannot verify cavitation vs blockage conclusion
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: accept ~4 m margin as calculated and pursue blockage/silt/vorticity as cavitation-mark causes; reason - report explicitly rules out NPSHa as root cause on that basis

rfi.issue: Vibration limits: BS ISO excludes submersibles, WIMES has no 2-vane class; magnetic temporary transducer not on bearing housing per WIMES 70-120% BEP protocol
rfi.item: Applicable vibration limit and method deviation
rfi.reason: Need a defensible pass/fail despite standard gaps
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: adopt 11.2 mm/s RMS as reasonable acceptance limit for 2-channel pump; reason - report justification, and all tests significantly exceed it regardless of method

rfi.issue: Pipe/manifold pressure rating and gasket specification not stated, yet gasket failures and 13-20 bar.g surge peaks reported
rfi.reason: Cannot judge if peaks explain gasket failures without rating
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: treat calculated peaks comparatively as evidence of slam risk, rating to be confirmed by CRT; reason - report links ball-valve slam, untied adaptors and residual moments to failures

rfi.issue: Lock 50 low/high level setpoints, ramp details beyond 30 s, and plinth/foundation fixity quantities (torques, grout, crack widths) not given
rfi.reason: Optimisation and re-anchoring design need these
rfi.resolution: ASSUMPTION: use fixed 48 Hz parallel level control as described and qualitative poor-anchorage evidence (comparable plate vibration, cracking/seepage, touch test); reason - only evidence quoted, intrusive investigation still required as high priority

assumptions: Assess single-pump as firm capacity and two-pump parallel as installed peak; reason - Table 1 Duty/Assist (p.7) conflicts with fixed parallel duty/duty at 48 Hz (p.13) and tests cover both (p.12)
Adopt wet well 55.5 mAOD (p.7), pump CL 54.3 mAOD (p.7), discharge 127.6 mAOD (p.7) = 72 m rise (p.7) as static basis; reason - only quoted levels, raw pressures/depths/GPS (p.9) not tabulated
Treat extra K=120 (p.11) as anomaly vs clean-pipe friction; reason - <25 years DI main (p.11) should not need K120 to match SCADA (p.11)
Model worst case intermediate NRVs failed open (p.19) for surge/head; reason - condition unknown under concrete covers remote (p.7), report does this (p.19)
Accept installed magflow (p.9, p.13) as reference with uncertainty; reason - same meter for test and SCADA (p.11, p.13) but not used for control (p.13)
Use STRING wire-to-water incl VSD from VSD input (p.12) for comparisons; reason - VSD/motor/pump split not given and 224.0 kW (p.12) exceeds 215 kW motor (p.7)

capacity_table.unit: Rising main DN600 3602 m 72 m rise to 127.6 mAOD (p.7)

capacity_table.binds_at: All flows; Aug 2019 30% screen loss and 40 tonnes silt/brick/vegetation (p.19) with pipework clear (p.19)
capacity_table.evidence: Large wide well low velocity/dead spots (p.19) with baffles satisfactory (p.20); 78 mm twin-passage (p.18) with 2 events since Nov 2017 (p.18) plus July 2019 inspection (p.18); NPSH ~4 m margin (p.12) and volute primed (p.12) so pitting (p.14) is blockage/silt-induced (p.12) not NPSHa

findings.evidence: K120 needed on <25yr DI main (p.11) to match SCADA; +6 m at 300 l/s (p.11) = 224 mm orifice (p.11). F1P50K120 200.0 l/s at 78.01 m 223.7 kW (F1P50K120) vs 199-201 l/s single 50 Hz (p.12); S1-48-K120 172.3 l/s at 76.54 m 189.2 kW (S1-48-K120) vs 168 l/s single 48 Hz (p.12). Rising main 3602 m DN600 72 m rise to 127.6 mAOD (p.7), no bursts since 1996 (p.7).
findings.limiting_value: Excess K120-170 anomaly range; clean pipe overpredicts flow, dual needs higher K - flow-dependent valve/air/blockage signature
findings.modification: Desilt wet well, CCTV/pressure-log/air-valve survey, lift/test NRV1 1270 m + NRV2 2410 m with bypasses (p.7), find partly-closed/stuck valve or air/partial blockage

findings.evidence: All tests >11.2 mm/s RMS (p.15); dual 48 Hz averages X12.6 Y13.5 Z16.4 (p.16); single 50 Hz maxima up to 37.5 mm/s pump 27.8 mm/s plate (p.16); plate comparable to pump (p.15) with cracking/seepage (p.15), touch reduction (p.17), vertical base-anchored motor unsupported (p.17); dual left of POR (p.15) vs POR 70-120% BEP (p.14); bearings 2000-3000 h vs 50000 h (p.14), seized/seals failed/pitting (p.14), BEP 262 l/s @70 m (p.11)
findings.limiting_value: >11.2 mm/s RMS (p.15 ASSUMPTION judgement), up to 37.5 mm/s (p.16); bearing life 2000-3000 h vs 50000 h (p.14)
findings.modification: Re-anchor/grout plinths, add motor-end support, tie manifold, move NRVs to 3-5D, return to single-pump POR duty

findings.evidence: Ball checks poor dynamic response (p.18) <3-5D from pump (p.18) with untied adaptors/braced manifold/residual moments (p.19); gaskets failed (p.18); VariSim at 48 Hz: 17.5 bar.g 2-pump trip, 20 bar.g 1-pump trip, 13 bar.g 30 s ramp (p.19) NRVs assumed failed open (p.19); steady F1P50K120 7.77 bar, S1-48-K120 7.63 bar give no warning
findings.limiting_value: 13-20 bar.g transient comparative only (p.19) vs steady ~7.6-7.8 bar (F1P50K120, S1-48-K120); rating to be confirmed
findings.modification: Low-slam reflux, tie/anchor manifold, transient protection + rating check; inspect buried NRVs (p.7)

findings.evidence: Fixed parallel duty/duty 48 Hz (p.13) via Lock 50 telemetry (p.13) 30 s ramp (p.7); 48 Hz lowest specific (p.13) corrected to kWh/ML: S1-48-K120 304.9 kWh/ML (S1-48-K120) vs F1P50K120 310.8 kWh/ML (F1P50K120); single 48 Hz 68-71% vs dual 64-66% (p.12); 224 kW (p.12) >215 kW motor (p.7); daily 0-23000 m3/day (p.13), magflow not for control (p.13), BEP 262 l/s (p.11)
findings.limiting_value: Dual parallel wastes energy vs sequential single; 50 Hz single overload, 45 Hz deeper left-of-BEP; VSD saving only at 48 Hz single
findings.modification: Sequential Duty/Assist single-pump control using calibrated magflow (p.13) + Lock 50 levels; retain 48 Hz, avoid 45 Hz dual and 50 Hz overload

findings.evidence: NPSHa margin ~4 m (p.12), volute primed (p.12); 30% screen loss + 40 tonnes silt/brick/vegetation (p.19), pipework clear (p.19); wide large well dead spots (p.19), baffles satisfactory (p.20); 78 mm 2-vane (p.18) with 2 debris events since Nov 2017 (p.18); benching Fig12 (p.20) with buffer/access trade-off (p.20), 0.3D-0.5D clearance (p.19)

issues.evidence: Rerun CAL-1P48: 185.8 kW / 175.9 l/s = 0.293 kWh/m3 = 29.3 kWh/100m3 = 293.4 kWh/ML. Report/Study EN-02 quotes 310.0 kWh/100m3 (p.12) for 187.5 kW / 168 l/s which computes to ~31 kWh/100m3. Numerically report value matches kWh/ML, not kWh/100m3. Factor ~10 error propagated through EN-01 to EN-10 and energy comparisons.
issues.issue: Specific-energy unit error: values labelled kWh/100m3 are numerically kWh/ML (off by 10x). Study repeats without catch; simulator specific_energy_kwh_per_ml ~293 vs quoted 310 comparison is unit-inconsistent.
issues.item: Energy performance metric and EN-01 to EN-10

issues.evidence: Calibration uses K120 for single-pump runs (CAL-1P50-K120, CAL-1P48 p.11) but K170 for dual 48Hz base run CAL-2P48-K170 to get residual 1.7% vs 266-267 l/s (p.12). K120 alone gives 284.4 l/s (CAL-2P48) +6.9% high. Single loss coefficient cannot be both 120 and 170.
issues.issue: Inconsistent anomaly coefficient: needing higher K at higher flow to match SCADA/test indicates fitting, not physical loss. Quantified penalty +2.14m single (74.57m HYP-CLEAN-1P48 to 76.71m CAL-1P48) and +5.76m dual (79.27m HYP-CLEAN-2P48 to 85.03m CAL-2P48-K170) and ~58.3 l/s gain depend on which K adopted. Flow-dependent anomaly (valve/air/blockage) not separated.

issues.evidence: Surge peaks 17.5, 20, 13 bar.g VariSim assuming intermediate NRVs failed open (p.19) with condition unknown under concrete covers remote (p.7) and pipe/gasket rating not stated yet gaskets failed (p.18). Steady reruns give JH 7.33-8.34 bar (CAL-1P48, CAL-2P48-K170, ALT-1P48-CLEAN) with no transient warning; study notes this.
issues.issue: Surge causation and valve-replacement benefit not verified with simulator: steady EPANET runs cannot model check-valve slam; no transient rerun of low-slam reflux. Rating to be confirmed, so 13-20 bar.g exceedance and gasket-failure link is comparative only. Alternative costed $100k-$1M on unconfirmed rating/operability.

issues.evidence: p.15 states BS ISO 10816-7 scope excludes submersibles, WIMES 1.03 has no 2-vane class (multivane >=3, single-channel), magnetic temporary transducer at drive end above volute + plate corner (p.15) not WIMES bearing-housing 70-120% BEP protocol. Study ASSUMPTION adopts 11.2 mm/s RMS as reasonable (p.15). All tests exceed it (p.15, p.16 e.g. up to 37.5 mm/s pump, 27.8 mm/s plate).
issues.issue: Vibration acceptance limit and method deviation: 11.2 mm/s applied to CT3240 2-vane (p.7, p.15, p.18) outside standard scope by engineering judgement. Conclusion robust (large exceedance) but limit not code-compliant; using 11.2 vs 7.1 multivane is less conservative.

issues.evidence: EN-01: 224.0 kW input (p.12) vs Rated Motor Output 215 kW (p.7). EN-09 192-201 kW per pump dual 50Hz (p.12). Power via temporary Fluke at VSD input (p.9), STRING incl VSD (p.12). Study RFI notes exceedance but retains as comparison without overload flag.
issues.issue: Potential motor overload at single 50Hz (224 kW >215 kW rating) not flagged as risk/cause; VSD/motor/pump split unknown so cannot isolate. Operating at 50Hz should carry overload warning.

issues.evidence: Flow via existing electromagnetic flowmeter (p.9) not utilised for control (p.13), calibration/uncertainty and 2018 daily 0-23000 m3/day SCADA estimation method (p.13) not stated. Same meter used for test and SCADA correlation (p.11). Study ASSUMPTION accepts as reference with noted uncertainty.
issues.issue: Flow measurement uncertainty propagates to system-curve K, POR position and specific-energy ranking; no independent check. Optimised sequential control using magflow (p.13) depends on unproven accuracy.

issues.evidence: NPSHa margin ~4m (p.12), volute below canal primed (p.12) with alternative causes blockage/silt (p.12). Inputs (levels, vapour, suction losses with 30% silted screens (p.19)) not tabulated; raw suction/delivery pressures, wet-well depths, GPS (p.9) not shown. Study ASSUMPTION accepts margin.
issues.issue: NPSH calculation cannot be independently verified; exclusion of NPSHa as cavitation-pitting cause (pitting noted p.14) rests on unseen calculation, especially with partially clogged screens/skewed flow/air entrainment (p.19).

issues.evidence: p.17 excerpt: critical length 6-7m, first support <=2.3m then 4.8m; sentence 'The as built installation has pipe' truncated in available text; supports claimed within distances. Manifold bracing/tied coupling/residual moments (p.19), untied adaptors (p.19), vertical base-anchored motor unsupported (p.17), cracking/seepage (p.15) noted.
issues.issue: Pipe-support compliance citation incomplete in source text; cannot verify as-built spacings achieve Xylem criteria. Foundation fixity (torques/grout/crack widths) and Lock 50 setpoints also not given - re-anchoring design still needs intrusive check as study notes high priority.

issues.evidence: p.16 Table 4 header states Average Min Max but row 1+2 48Hz 266 l/s reads 10.80 14.30 12.60 (X), 11.30 17.60 13.50 (Y), 14.50 17.90 16.40 (Z) where last value is average (min-max-average order). Study VIB-06 quotes averages X12.6 Y13.5 Z16.4 correctly but source header order misleading.
issues.issue: Table 4 column order mislabelled; requires reader to infer min-max-average. Minor transcription risk but averages used correctly.

responses.issue: Specific-energy unit error: values labelled kWh/100m3 are numerically kWh/ML (off by 10x). Study repeats without catch; simulator specific_energy_kwh_per_ml ~293 vs quoted 310 comparison is unit-inconsistent.
responses.explanation: Accepted: re-run F1P50K120 gives 223.7 kW / 200.0 l/s = 310.8 kWh/ML (F1P50K120) matching report ~310 numerically; S1-48-K120 gives 304.9 kWh/ML. All report Table 3 values labelled kWh/100m3 (p.12) are corrected to kWh/ML in findings. Energy ranking unchanged, magnitudes 10x smaller per 100m3.

responses.explanation: Accepted as fitting flag: K120 (p.11) reproduces single-pump tests (F1P50K120 200.0 l/s; S1-48-K120 172.3 l/s vs 168 l/s p.12) but under-predicts dual loss. Retained as K120-170 anomaly range indicating flow-squared excess loss on 3602m DN600 main (p.7). Diagnosis revised to flow-dependent anomaly (partly-closed/stuck NRV1 1270m/NRV2 2410m (p.7), air, partial blockage) requiring CCTV/pressure-logging/lift covers, not single physical K.

responses.issue: Potential motor overload at single 50Hz (224 kW >215 kW rating) not flagged as risk/cause; VSD/motor/pump split unknown so cannot isolate. Operating at 50Hz should carry overload warning.
responses.explanation: Accepted and flagged: Rated Motor Output 215 kW (p.7) vs EN-01 224.0 kW input (p.12) via Fluke at VSD input (p.9) exceeds rating. Recommend avoid 50 Hz single, investigate VSD/motor efficiency split.

responses.issue: Flow measurement uncertainty propagates to system-curve K, POR position and specific-energy ranking; no independent check. Optimised sequential control using magflow (p.13) depends on unproven accuracy.
